report.title: 2025 Consumer Confidence Report - Thousand Trails Morgan Hill, CA4300615 (dated June 30, 2026, prepared by MCSI Water Systems Management)

sources_described: Thousand Trails Morgan Hill is supplied by one groundwater well, Well 01, located within the Park. The source assessment found the well most vulnerable to septic systems (low), not associated with any detected contaminants.

extraction_notes: Tables: Table 1 (lead/copper) and Table 2 (sodium/hardness) on PDF page 3; Table 3 primary standards - Source on page 4; Table 3A primary standards - Distribution and Table 4 secondary standards on page 5. No violations table and no coliform table. Table 3 and 3A have a 'Level Detected (Average)' column; values in parentheses are averages. Table 3A's three rows (TTHM 0.72 / ND-4.39, HAA5 0.19, chlorine 4.39) exactly repeat the Table 3 nitrate, hexavalent chromium and gross alpha values, which strongly suggests a copy/paste error in the report; they are copied as printed and flagged in notes (the chlorine figure would exceed the MRDL if real). Unit misprints copied as printed: iron 98 'mg/L' against SMCL 0.3, specific conductance in 'µg/L', hexavalent chromium with no unit. Sample dates are month/year or year only.
